READ-1.name: UNWANTED

READ-10.name: TOO_MANY_AT_ONCE
READ-10.description: Raised where more holdings were asked for than one read answers with.

READ-12.name: NO_SUCH_REMOVAL

READ-13.name: NO_UPDATE_OBJECT

READ-14.name: NOT_A_LINE_COUNT

READ-16.name: MEMBER_AND_DEFAULTS

READ-2.name: REPEATED

READ-4.name: NO_TERM

READ-5.name: NOT_A_SEASON
READ-5.description: Raised where the season to narrow a trace to is not a number.

READ-6.name: NO_SETTING
READ-6.description: Raised where a setting was asked for by an empty name.

READ-7.name: NO_MEMBER
READ-7.description: Raised where a household member was asked for by an empty name.

READ-8.name: NO_SHELF_WITHOUT_A_MEMBER
READ-8.description: Raised where a shelf was asked for and nobody was named whose it is.

READ-9.name: NOT_A_COUNT
READ-9.description: Raised where how many holdings to answer with is not a whole number.
